summary: Feed s074_single to NDR is degraded due to 13.2% duplicate packets (343/2595) exceeding 5% threshold. All other checks healthy: bidirectional traffic present, no truncation, drops, overload, oversize, tunnel or encryption issues.

findings.root_cause: Traffic likely aggregated from SPAN/mirror sessions on both sides of the same link or from redundant TAP paths without broker deduplication, causing the same packet to be forwarded twice to the tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR wastes CPU/storage on duplicate reassembly, inflates flow counts and alerts, skews behavioral baselines and reduces effective detection coverage; at 13.2% duplicates efficiency is significantly reduced even though tool is not yet overloaded.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication to drop identical packets within a short window before delivery, restoring 1:1 traffic fidelity for the NDR without losing coverage.
